mentions.name: Clicksheet
mentions.description: Clicksheet is a tool for uploading many CSV files to Google Sheets, built to eliminate the repetitive daily work of uploading dozens of CSV files one by one.
mentions.problem: Wasting large amounts of time dealing with uploading tens of CSV files to Google Sheets on a daily basis.
mentions.source_excerpt: Recently launched https://clicksheet.pro/ because I wasted so much time dealing with uploading 10's of csv files to google sheets on a daily basis. If you're in operations, this will be interesting for you.
